Airdrop project management · Wallet tracking · Personal accounting

Airdrop Hunter does not create, custody, or store wallet private keys or recovery phrases. Signing and transaction confirmation are handled by external wallets. Connect only to trusted sites and review every request in your wallet.
No readable external wallet account session is currently available

External wallet connections are managed by their wallet apps. This version does not simulate a local disconnect. To end a session, revoke it in the connected-sites or session settings of MetaMask, OKX Wallet, or the relevant wallet app.
No website origins are currently authorized
This permission is valid only for the current process and wallet session. It is cleared automatically when the session changes.

Site permissions are kept in memory and are not persisted across app processes. After revocation, the site can no longer access the authorized account through this app. Reauthorization requires your confirmation.

Community directory projects participate in de-identified statistics by default. Entries without a transaction hash are counted as self-reported; entries with a hash must pass on-chain verification. Private projects are included only in your personal ledger.
